newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Worthington Foods raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Worthington Foods raised.

text.p: -- Robinson Humphrey analyst David Goldman said he upgraded his near-term rating on Worthington Foods to buy from market perform, keeping his long-term buy.
-- Said stock was "cheap" after falling 20 percent from its February high at 21-3/4.
-- Said he raised his 1997 earnings per share estimate on the company to $1.10 from $0.98 and 1998 view to $1.38 from $1.15.
-- Has 12-month target of $27-$28 on the stock, which closed Thursday 17-3/4.
